entities.summary: Ago Künnap is an Estonian linguist and Uralist, whose work has focused especially on Samoyedic languages and Uralic historical morphology. He has been affiliated with the University of Tartu, where he became a professor and later emeritus professor.

entities.summary: Ago Künnap is an Estonian linguist and Uralist, whose work has focused especially on Samoyedic languages and Uralic historical morphology. He has been affiliated with the University of Tartu, where he became a professor and later emeritus professor.
